proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ G Y Z hG hY hZ hZm
  set W := MeasureTheory.condExp G P Y with hW
  have hWL : MeasureTheory.MemLp W 2 P := hY.condExp
  have hWm : @MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable Ω ℝ _ G W := MeasureTheory.stronglyMeasurable_condExp
  have hDL : MeasureTheory.MemLp (W - Z) 2 P := hWL.sub hZ
  have hDm : @MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable Ω ℝ _ G (W - Z) := hWm.sub hZm
  have hYi : MeasureTheory.Integrable Y P := hY.integrable one_le_two
  have hDY : MeasureTheory.Integrable ((W - Z) * Y) P := hDL.integrable_mul hY
  have hDW : MeasureTheory.Integrable ((W - Z) * W) P := hDL.integrable_mul hWL
  have hpull := MeasureTheory.condExp_mul_of_stronglyMeasurable_left (μ := P) (m := G) hDm hDY hYi
  have horth : ∫ ω, ((W - Z) * Y) ω ∂P = ∫ ω, ((W - Z) * W) ω ∂P := by
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_condExp hG (f := (W - Z) * Y)]
    exact MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae hpull
  have h1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => (Y ω - W ω) ^ 2) P := (hY.sub hWL).integrable_sq
  have h2 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => (W ω - Z ω) ^ 2) P := hDL.integrable_sq
  have h3 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => 2 * (((W - Z) * Y) ω - ((W - Z) * W) ω)) P := (hDY.sub hDW).const_mul 2
  have hexp : ∫ ω, (Y ω - Z ω) ^ 2 ∂P = ∫ ω, (Y ω - W ω) ^ 2 ∂P + ∫ ω, (W ω - Z ω) ^ 2 ∂P + ∫ ω, 2 * (((W - Z) * Y) ω - ((W - Z) * W) ω) ∂P := by
    have e1 : ∫ ω, (Y ω - W ω) ^ 2 + (W ω - Z ω) ^ 2 ∂P = ∫ ω, (Y ω - W ω) ^ 2 ∂P + ∫ ω, (W ω - Z ω) ^ 2 ∂P := MeasureTheory.integral_add h1 h2
    have e2 : ∫ ω, ((Y ω - W ω) ^ 2 + (W ω - Z ω) ^ 2) + 2 * (((W - Z) * Y) ω - ((W - Z) * W) ω) ∂P = ∫ ω, (Y ω - W ω) ^ 2 + (W ω - Z ω) ^ 2 ∂P + ∫ ω, 2 * (((W - Z) * Y) ω - ((W - Z) * W) ω) ∂P := MeasureTheory.integral_add (h1.add h2) h3
    rw [← e1, ← e2]
    refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => ?_)
    simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Pi.sub_apply]
    ring
  have hzero : ∫ ω, 2 * (((W - Z) * Y) ω - ((W - Z) * W) ω) ∂P = 0 := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, MeasureTheory.integral_sub hDY hDW, horth]
    simp
  have hnn : 0 ≤ ∫ ω, (W ω - Z ω) ^ 2 ∂P := MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg fun ω => sq_nonneg _
  rw [hexp, hzero]
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (G : MeasurableSpace Ω) (Y Z : Ω → ℝ), G ≤ m0 → MeasureTheory.MemLp Y 2 P → MeasureTheory.MemLp Z 2 P → @MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable Ω ℝ _ G Z → ∫ ω, (Y ω - (MeasureTheory.condExp G P Y) ω) ^ 2 ∂P ≤ ∫ ω, (Y ω - Z ω) ^ 2 ∂P
